claim: The 2.08x gap at Decoda plane 0 is recoverable by reordering residual bitplanes
evidence: At plane 0 there are zero residual planes by construction; the gap lives entirely in the ternary base (1.6 b/w) + alpha (0.5) + CSR (0.82) + sign bitset (1.0). Reordering operates on planes that do not exist at plane 0. Closing the gap requires replacing the ternary base, not reordering planes.
